notes.title: Now Available in Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758212/a2f6f12764e2fa16b9f75657634ed9c80050ed3c.jpg[/img]

Great news people!
Practical Shooting Simulator available in Steam Early Access. You can buy, test, and write all sorts of words to developers. Because this is far from the end.

This was a very hard and important milestone for us. And we need your help, feedback, and suggestions. Thanks to everyone that you are still with us!

notes.title: Early Access Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758212/27461f0c7757dac0dac7fd902f8fbe6f3705f645.png[/img]

Good news people!
Thanks to everyone who took part in testing the Simulator and helped us make it better.

A significantly updated version of the Simulator will be released into Early Access literally in the coming days. Because of that, all beta keys have been revoked. Don't panic.

Going into Early Access is not the end of development. We still have a lot of work to do. And we still count on your feedback and support.

notes.title: Get ready for Alpha Test
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758212/0356eacf7bc5092be6a04c33bed1aa27810e7659.jpg[/img]

Alright, people! Alpha testing will start soon. To participate:
- Send an email with a short story about yourself to beta@269thlab.com
- Do not forget to include "Simulator Tester" in the subject.

Testing is a serious thing considering the specifics of the Simulator. Thanks in advance everyone! No kidding, this is very important to us.
